look: Stylised 3D still in exactly the designer art-toy style of the reference pictures (vinyl-and-felt figures, matte skin, hair as one solid sculpted shape, real fabric clothes with a coarse soft weave), set in a sunny hand-built model town: painted houses in cream, terracotta, mint and sky blue, cobbled streets, plain cream bunting, lemon trees in terracotta pots. Low golden late-afternoon sun coming from the LEFT, long warm violet shadows. The characters are exactly those of the reference pictures, unchanged: TIMO (tall and thin, black flat-top, dark brown skin, teal track jacket with a cream sleeve stripe, navy trousers, tiny teal backpack, big yellow watch on his left wrist, teal-and-coral scarf knotted short at the throat), LUNA (short, coral bob with a full fringe, freckles, coral football shirt with a cream collar, light-blue denim shorts, cream socks, chunky cream trainers, her own long knitted scarf in ONE plain teal colour, with no coral, no stripe and no pattern anywhere on it), BIG YELLOW (the giant sunflower-yellow hard-shell suitcase with dark-violet wheels and one short fixed handle; standing upright its flat top reaches Luna's chest) and the fat ginger CAT with the cream belly and half-closed eyes. Vertical 9:16 film frame, eye-level camera, 28mm lens, soft background. No letters, numbers, signs, logos or clock faces anywhere.
film: Polished stylised 3D animation of designer art-toy figures, like a frame-by-frame animated short: they act like living people, with expressive eyebrows and mouths, clear poses, clean arcs and real weight; snappy, never floaty. Nothing morphs, bends, melts or changes shape, colour or size; clothes, scarves, props and the background stay exactly as in the first frame. THE CAMERA IS LOCKED OFF ON A TRIPOD: it does not move, pan, tilt, zoom, push in or pull back; the framing of the first frame is the framing of the last frame. Golden late-afternoon light from the left. No music. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text, no letters.

shots.still: THE PICTURE: the same small room, the same window on the left, the same violet bean bag, the same wide framing and golden light as the FIRST reference picture. Change this: the back wall is now BARE. All the notes, strings and the paper stadium are gone: only rows of small empty pins and pale squares where papers used to hang, and in the exact middle of the wall ONE small blank ivory sheet of paper on one pin. TIMO stands on the RIGHT, very straight and proud, chin up, one arm stretched toward the single sheet like a teacher, mouth closed in a proud smile; teal track jacket with cream sleeve stripes, navy trousers, teal-and-coral scarf, the two straps of his tiny teal backpack on his shoulders, big yellow watch on his LEFT wrist; he holds nothing and there is no folder anywhere in the room. LUNA lies sprawled on the big violet bean bag on the LEFT, one leg over its side, a plain orange basketball (no logo, no writing) resting on her stomach under one arm, looking up at the wall with one eyebrow raised, mouth closed; coral football shirt, denim shorts, long plain teal scarf. BIG YELLOW, the giant yellow suitcase, stands closed and upright right beside the bean bag, and the fat ginger CAT lies loafed on its flat top, asleep. Both faces are clearly visible in the middle band of the frame; the top fifth of the frame is only bare wall. Only Timo, Luna, the suitcase and the cat.
shots.video: @Timo sweeps his arm across the empty wall, ends pointing at the single sheet with his chin up, and says, proud and lively, like a presenter: "No notes. No folder. One sentence." He ends beaming. @Luna, lying on the bean bag with the basketball, only looks up at the wall, one eyebrow raised. The cat sleeps on the suitcase. The wall does not change. One continuous shot. Nobody else appears. Sound: his voice, a quiet room.

shots.video: @Luna pushes the heavy suitcase slowly from right to left, leaning hard, with a small grunt. Ahead of her @Timo strolls at the same slow speed, hands clasped behind his head, and says without looking back, light and smug: "I carry one sentence." The cat rides on the suitcase without moving. shots.video: @Luna says, bright, playful and teasing, in her usual high lively voice, full of energy: "My turn. Golf!" The folder stays under her arm and the screen of the phone is never seen. One continuous shot. Nobody else appears. Sound: only her voice and soft thumb taps; the phone makes no chime, no beep and no notification sound.
